# Subscribe setup formats status text before starting server population

SetUpTree awaits the localized waiting string before reporting start status and calling startPopulating. Offline and generic-error status strings are formatted separately in its catch. Actual callers start setup without awaiting it, and OnDonePopulating performs the later completion UI work. The document links subscribe.ftl and builds protocol-specific subscribe IDs; the submitted subcribe typo is absent from final source. Keep formatting, caller return and population completion as separate source boundaries. No server, migration, dialog or accessibility execution ran.

Scope: Subscribe dialog Fluent and population boundary.
